title: "Do Anything Now": Characterizing and Evaluating In-The-Wild Jailbreak Prompts on Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper extensively evaluates LLMs' resistance to 'forbidden scenarios' (e.g., Hate Speech, Physical Harm, Fraud) which are defined by OpenAI's usage policy to promote 'safe and ethical behavior'. The core of the paper is benchmarking how well LLMs and their safeguards adhere to these ethical guidelines when faced with jailbreak prompts.
